goal: Measure the reported facial asymmetry and consolidate the functional-mouth blocker without modifying the inherited GLB

environment.analysis: dependency-free GLB accessor inspection; Blender runtime not available in this execution

steps: Parse the unchanged GLB and select LOD0 head vertices by Bip01 Head influence
Measure nearest mirrored partners on X in rest mesh coordinates
Review prior jaw-channel and all-action findings
Add non-destructive diagnostics and agent instructions; do not alter or promote the model
observations: All 974 evaluated non-center head vertices were outside the effective mirrored-pair tolerance; median nearest-partner distance 1.062354 and maximum 3.626402 GLB mesh units.
The measurement confirms geometric asymmetry but does not choose a donor side or prove that every difference is undesirable.
Prior evidence shows Bone02 rotates and has weights; the inherited fused mouth and hinge topology remain the functional blocker.
No candidate geometry was produced and no artistic, Unity or final approval is claimed.

The previous validator could sample only selected frames, associate the wrong armature, test a mesh against itself and return process success after a failed gate; it was replaced with explicit-role, all-frame validation.
